notReady.title: Profile not ready
notReady.description: We couldn't find your profile yet. Please complete onboarding first.

photo.title: Profile Photo
photo.description: Your photo appears on your public profile
photo.hint: JPG, PNG or GIF. Max 2MB. Recommended 400x400px.

fillFromCv.label: Fill from CV
fillFromCv.hint: Auto-fill these fields from your most recent uploaded CV. You can edit anything before saving.

skills.title: Skills & Expertise
skills.description: Key skills that define your professional identity
skills.placeholder: Add a skill (e.g., React, Python, AI/ML)

publicSettings.title: Public Profile Settings
publicSettings.description: Control what recruiters can see and do
publicSettings.privateNote: Your profile is private. Turn on Public Profile Visibility above to claim a public URL and share it.

slug.label: Profile username
slug.hint: 3–40 characters. Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. Must be unique.

visibility.title: Public Profile Visibility
visibility.description: Anyone with the link can view your profile

chat.title: Allow AI Chat
chat.description: Let recruiters chat with your AI persona

jobFit.title: Allow Job-Fit Analysis
jobFit.description: Let recruiters analyze job descriptions against your profile

contact.title: Allow Contact Form
contact.description: Let recruiters send you direct messages

citations.title: Show Document Citations
citations.description: Display source references in AI responses

feedback.slugFormat: Use lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens (no leading or trailing hyphen).
